description: Earth's energy-budget closure, 2005-2020. Literature values, rounded to 0.01 W/m2 and cited; cross-check the source tables before quoting as exact (Rule of Three).
unit: W m^-2, global mean, positive = the Earth system is gaining energy

sources.eei_ceres: Loeb et al. 2021, 'Satellite and Ocean Data Reveal Marked Increase in Earth's Heating Rate', Geophys. Res. Lett. 48, e2021GL093047. CERES Earth energy imbalance, 2005-2019 mean = 0.77 W/m2 (net TOA radiative flux).
sources.components: von Schuckmann et al. 2023, 'Heat stored in the Earth system 1960-2020: where does the energy go?', Earth Syst. Sci. Data 15, 1675-1709. Component heat uptake, 2006-2020 mean.
